meta.subtitle: A documentation kit that renders JSON or Markdown pages in the browser. Single-source content, no build step for authoring, multi-page site with full-text search when you want one.
meta.summary: What the kit is, how it's organised, where the documentation lives.

blocks.summary: Pages are JSON or Markdown. The browser renders them via Custom Elements; no build step needed to read. Run html-doc build to emit a multi-page site (with Pagefind search) or a standalone single file for offline reading.
bullets: Source: <name>.json (kit schema) or <name>.md (existing Markdown drops in unchanged).
Runtime: chrome.js + renderer.js load from a _kit symlink. No copies, no version drift.
Primitives: callout, kpi-grid, table, compare-grid, step-flow, chart, diagram, live-snippet, annotated-code, glossary tooltips, citation cards.
Output: dist/site/ (multi-page + Pagefind) and dist/standalone/ (single file with inline page JSON for email / archive).

blocks.title: Documentation
blocks.lead: Four pages. Read the Reference first; the others go deeper on their topics.

steps.title: Reference
content: Project setup, page anatomy, Markdown sources, every primitive with its JSON shape and a live example, per-page metadata, build outputs.

steps.title: Glossary & ext-refs
content: File layout, multi-language entries, project overrides, disambiguation syntax, resolution algorithm.

steps.title: Architecture
content: How the kit fits together at runtime — render flow, tooltip controller, kit loader, build pipeline, standalone bundle. Read this when extending or debugging the kit itself.

steps.title: CLI reference
content: Four commands. What each does, what output to expect, the doctree linter's severity table, the optional Pagefind and jsonschema dependencies.

blocks.title: What a page looks like
blocks.lead: The same page authored two ways — JSON for kit-native content, Markdown for existing docs that should drop in unchanged.

cards.title: JSON source
cards.content: Hand-authored or AI-emitted. Every block declares its kind explicitly; nothing has to be guessed.

cards.title: Markdown source
cards.content: Drop existing .md files into the docs root. ATX headings, code fences (mermaid included), lists, tables, blockquotes, inline formatting all convert. Relative .md links retarget to .html.

blocks.title: Quickstart
blocks.lead: Three commands. Adopt the kit for an existing docs/ directory without rewriting anything.

blocks.source:
cd path/to/your-project/docs
html-doc init     # creates _kit symlink + index.html
html-doc serve    # http://localhost:9876 with live reload
